- Cost sensitivity: target cost per query < $0.02 at steady state. Wants tradeoff options: cheaper approximate retrieval + sparse rerank vs. always-run cross-encoder.
- Re-index compute constraints: cannot have long-running full rebuilds that interrupt production. Prefer background compaction on dedicated capacity.
